title: Qt: Update the last used time of a filter when applied
description:
Update the last used time of a filter when it is applied,
not when the ComboBox is activated - the latter includes
selecting before filtering, including using keyboard navigation,
and thus renders keyboard navigation impossible.

Also reset the index after the clear button.

Fix #20133
